text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated support about \"a chance to do your best\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a more recognizable overall structure with an introduction, supporting examples, and a closing restatement."},{"evidence":"\"I agree with this statement because...\" and later \"when you have a problem its your chance to try/succeed\"","quality":"thesis development","description":"The essay states its main point more directly and returns to it in a way that shows a more coherent line of argument."},{"evidence":"\"The coach always got mad at me\" \"I search up...\" \"It helped me a lot\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay gives a more focused personal example with a problem, an action taken, and a result."},{"evidence":"\"Sometimes I gave up because I forget to pass the ball\" \"now I started trying my best\"","quality":"control of meaning","description":"The essay communicates its ideas more clearly and consistently, even with errors, so the reader can follow the intended message more easily."},{"evidence":"\"I never passed the ball to my teammates\" \"every game i have passed the ball\"","quality":"sentence completeness","description":"The essay contains more complete, manageable sentences rather than long run-on stretches that obscure the message."}]}
